steps.en: Install and start the Langflow server
steps.zh: 安装并启动 Langflow 服务
steps.code: uv pip install langflow -U · uv run langflow run

steps.en: On the canvas, connect components (input, model, retriever, tools, output) and add model keys
steps.zh: 在画布上把组件（输入、模型、检索器、工具、输出）连起来，填好模型密钥

steps.en: Runs the flow step by step in the Playground, showing each component's output
steps.zh: 在 Playground 里一步步运行流程，展示每个组件的输出

steps.en: Call the saved flow from your app with an API key
steps.zh: 在你的应用里带上 API key 调用这个流程

steps.en: Executes the stored flow per request and returns its chat output; also serves it as an MCP tool
steps.zh: 每次请求都执行存好的流程并返回结果，同时把它作为 MCP 工具提供

component.zh: API + 项目级 MCP 服务器

value.en: A prototype you tested visually becomes an API and MCP tool without writing the integration glue
value.zh: 可视化试通的原型直接变成 API 和 MCP 工具，不用写集成胶水代码

sources: https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow#-quickstart (uv pip install langflow -U, uv run langflow run, http://127.0.0.1:7860; visual builder, interactive playground, deploy as API / MCP server)

https://docs.langflow.org/concepts-publish (curl --request POST --url http://LANGFLOW_SERVER_ADDRESS/api/v1/run/FLOW_ID --header x-api-key: LANGFLOW_API_KEY; each project has an MCP server exposing its flows as tools)
